info.title: BLIH Core Platform API
info.description:
Enterprise API surface for authentication, authorization, governance, notifications, and audit.

**Response envelope:** All HTTP responses return a standard envelope: `success`, `message`, `data`, `error`, and `meta` (`timestamp`, `requestId`, `version`, with optional `pagination`).



**[Export OpenAPI spec (JSON)](/api/v1/api/docs/download/openapi.json)** | **[YAML](/api/v1/api/docs/download/openapi.yaml)**

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Token validation, introspection, refresh, and session APIs.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User lifecycle management and credential operations.

tags.name: Positions
tags.description: Position catalog CRUD for reusable job titles.

tags.name: RBAC
tags.description: Role and permission management (2-part resource:action only), scoped assignment, and access evaluation.

tags.name: System Config
tags.description: Platform configuration, module flags, and security policy APIs.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Multi-channel notification dispatch, inbox retrieval, and read-state updates.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Audit trail recording, querying, and export.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Service liveness/dependency checks for operations and monitoring.
